props.gloss_en: Rava: they made one who does not acquire like one who acquires -- though it did not reach his hand, it is as if it reached his hand and he sold it to the Israelite in its blemish
R' Elazar: all concede regarding an uncertain firstborn whose replacement is not in the priest's hand, that it is obligated in the gifts
what you might have said: R' Yosei's reason is that if you obligate him in the gifts he will come to shearing and labor -- [so he exempts] even without a replacement in the priest's hand
the seifa: R' Yosei would say, whatever has its replacement in the priest's hand is exempt from the gifts
the seifa: and R' Meir obligates

what you might have said: R' Yosei spoke to R' Meir according to R' Meir's words -- for me, even without a replacement in the priest's hand [exempt, lest shearing and labor]; for you, concede at least where the replacement is in the priest's hand, for they made one who does not acquire like one who acquires; and R' Meir said to him: no
Rav Pappa: all concede regarding an uncertain tithe that it is exempt from the gifts
what you might have said: R' Meir's reason is lest the law of the gifts be forgotten -- [so he obligates] even an uncertain tithe too

what you might have said: R' Meir obligates even an uncertain tithe, and their disputing over the replacement is to tell you R' Yosei's strength, who exempts even where the priest comes upon him from two sides

questions.gloss_en: and R' Yosei, what is his reason?

objections.gloss_en: ומי מצית אמרת הכי? והתני סיפא: שהיה רבי יוסי אומר כל שחליפיו ביד כהן פטור מן המתנות ... חליפין ביד כהן -- אין, אין חליפין ביד כהן -- לא! (18a.15-18b.1)

answered_by.gloss_en: רבי יוסי לדבריו דרבי מאיר קאמר ליה -- the seifa's 'replacement' condition is R' Yosei arguing on R' Meir's terms, not his own limit (= p_hava_amina_yosei_lidvarav)
